info.title: DHCPV6_Server_Static_Host
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

properties.description:
Reference Resource: [DHCPV6_Server_Static_Host](#/DHCPV6_Server_Static_Host)
The desired static IPv6 address bindings for this pool.

client_hostname.description: Hostname that should be assigned to the specified host. This overrides any hostname configured on the DHCP client machine. This column value can be empty.

client_id.description: Client id or DUID of the DHCPv6 client to which the configured static IPv6 address would be assigned. If same client id is configured with multiple IPv6 addresses then none of the static address mappings will be applied.

ipv6_address.description:
Reference Resource: [DHCPV6_Server_Static_Host](#/DHCPV6_Server_Static_Host)
Static IPv6 address that should be assigned to the specific host. The specified IPv6 address is not constrained to be in the configured IPv6 range, but it must be in the same subnet as valid configured IPv6 range.

state.description: Completion status of static host IPv6 address mapping:  `OPERATIONAL`: static host mapping is fully operational. `CONFLICTING`: disabled due to multiple addresses assigned to the same client id.

parameters.name: VRF.name
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [VRF](#/VRF)
VRF identifier. Should be alphanumeric. VRF names must be unique.
